Definition: from a derivative of the alternate of G4095; to furnish drink, irrigate:--give (make) to drink, feed, water.
BiblicalUsage: Potizo means to give drink, to water, to feed. Jesus promises a reward for a cup of cold water given to a little one, and Paul says we have all been made to drink into one Spirit.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the smallest drink given in his name is never forgotten, and the Spirit himself is the water we all drink.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
